title: Knowledge document frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block at the top of every knowledge Markdown file under data/countries/<code>/knowledge/. The Markdown body below the frontmatter is the retrievable content; this schema governs only the metadata.

doc_id.description: Stable, unique-within-country id. Used for re-ingestion and deduplication. Lowercase, digits, hyphens.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Must match the parent countries/<code>/ folder.

authority.description: The issuing government body, e.g. USCIS, DOS, IRCC. Should match an authority declared in the country's meta.yaml.

forms.description: Official form numbers referenced by this document, e.g. [I-130, I-485].

tags.description: Optional free-form keywords to aid retrieval.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the document body.

source_url.description: Direct link to the source this document is based on.

source_type.description: 'official' MUST cite a domain listed in the country's meta.yaml official_domains (enforced by validate.py). 'secondary' is a reputable non-government source.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) a human last checked this against the source.
